property_summary: For all inputs, the reference contract reverts when initialize is called with feeRate > 5000 (enforcing the upper bound), whereas the mutant accepts and stores arbitrary feeRate values (so there exist inputs with feeRate > 5000 where reference revert but mutant does not).
change_summary: Remove the feeRate upper bound check so initialize allows any feeRate value (deleted the FeeRateTooHigh revert), which can result in a different stored feeRate after initialize.
